hooks.command: for p in ./bin/zqk ../bin/zqk "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/zqk"; do if [ -x "$p" ]; then exec "$p" agent hook pre-subagent --vendor antigravity; fi; done; exec zqk agent hook pre-subagent --vendor antigravity

Stop.command: for p in ./bin/zqk ../bin/zqk "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/zqk"; do if [ -x "$p" ]; then exec "$p" agent hook stop --vendor antigravity; fi; done; exec zqk agent hook stop --vendor antigravity
